training_dataset: IDRiD Segmentation (folder A) published train/test split: 54 train, 27 val (val = IDRiD's own 'Testing Set', NOT the sealed grading-test split). Missing mask files (e.g. many images have no Soft Exudates) treated as all-zero, not dropped.

eval_metrics.note: Dice computed only over images where either ground truth or prediction is non-empty for that class (images with neither are excluded, not counted as perfect). SE has far fewer positive examples than HE/EX (see 'training_dataset') so its Dice is measured on a smaller effective sample.
